description:
Motivation is cheap. Money on the line isn't.

GymTaxx turns your gym goal into a deposit contract with yourself. Lock a refundable deposit, commit to a weekly workout target, and earn back your own money one verified gym visit at a time. Skip a session, and that £5 stays locked. No hype, no gimmicks — just a system that makes showing up the easier option.

Choose your commitment level. Pick 3, 4 or 5 workouts a week and lock a matching deposit of £60, £80 or £100. Higher goal, higher stakes — you decide what pressure gets you moving.

Earn back what's yours. Every verified gym check-in unlocks £5 of your own deposit. There's no pot, no prize, no money from other users — you're only ever earning back what you put in.

Real humans check your check-ins. A live camera photo at the gym gets reviewed by an actual person, not an algorithm you can fool with an old screenshot. If a check-in isn't approved, you'll get clear feedback and a direct line to support before your week closes.

Monthly cohorts, shared start line. Every challenge kicks off on the first Monday of the month, running Monday to Sunday for four weeks. You're not doing this alone — everyone in your cohort started the same day you did.

See your progress at a glance. A simple ring shows money earned back, your current streak and workouts completed this week. Watching your own deposit unlock is a different kind of motivation.

Your data, your control. Delete your account and every check-in photo from inside the app whenever you want. No hoops, no waiting.

GymTaxx isn't about luck, chance or outcomes you can't control. It's about whether you show up. Lock your deposit, commit to the month, and make skipping the gym cost you something.

Download GymTaxx and put your own money where your motivation is.

promotionalText: Lock a refundable deposit. Earn back £5 per verified gym visit. New monthly cohorts start every first Monday — commit before this month's closes.
